description: Large recovered wreckage of a B-52 shot down over Hanoi during Operation Linebacker II in December 1972, laid out in the museum yard together with recovered engines. Sources differ on whether the main section is from a B-52D or a B-52G.
MiG-21 displayed in the museum yard alongside the SA-2 battery. No number recorded from a reliable source.
Two S-75 (SA-2 Guideline) systems with launchers and V-750 rounds, displayed with an SNR-75 Fan Song guidance radar and anti-aircraft guns (ZPU-1/2/4, 37 mm 61-K, 57 mm S-60, 100 mm KS-19).
aliases: SA-2; SA2; Guideline; V-750; S75; V750
